content: Hey Sam, how was your meeting today? I was thinking about you all morning. I hope it went well!
Hi! It was okay, just the usual back-to-back calls. Your texts always make the day feel lighter though. How are you?
Aww babe, that means a lot. I'm alright, just feeling a bit down. Something happened back home, but I don't want to bring the mood down unless you want to hear.
Of course I want to hear. You can tell me anything, you know that.
You're the sweetest, thank you. There's been really heavy flooding in my hometown. The orphanage I've supported for years is at risk of closing, they lost everything in the storm.
Oh my god, that's awful. Are you okay? Is everyone safe?
Most are safe but the kids have nowhere to stay now. I've been sending all I can, but the repairs are just too much. I feel helpless. I don't usually ask for help, you know...
You're always helping others. Is there any way I can help? Even just listening, I'm here for you.
Honestly, just having you listen means a lot. But if you want to help, even a small donation could make a real difference to these kids. I can send you the info if you'd like.
I'd like to help, yeah. Can you send me details? I really trust you on this.
Thank you so much, Sam. I'll send you the shelter's PayPal: orphanagehelpfund@gmail.com. Even $100 can buy beds for two kids. And I promise, I'll show you every receipt, they're family to me.
You're amazing for doing this. I'll send what I can after work tonight.
You have no idea how much this means. I'm so lucky to have someone as caring as you in my life. Let me know if you need help with the transfer.
Thanks. I'll do it through PayPal like you said. Is there anything else I should know?
Just make sure to select 'Friends & Family', that way there are no fees and it gets to the kids faster. Don't worry, everything is safe and transparent. You have my word.
Okay, I'll double check that. I trust you. I'll send you the confirmation as soon as I do.
Thank you, love. You're truly making a difference. I can't wait until we can meet in person and celebrate all the good you're doing.
Me too. Hope the kids are okay. Let me know if you hear any updates.
Absolutely, I'll keep you posted. And if you want, I can send you some photos once things settle. I wish more people had your heart.
That would be nice. I'm glad I can help, talk soon?
Of course! Message me anytime. And thank you again, Sam. You're a lifesaver.
